A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CSR research work. All 18 pages in each version, including Appendices A–E, are readable, and corresponding text, equations, figures and tables support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v3 reports original CSR experiments on image, text and multimodal representations, including benchmark scores, retrieval timings and ablations in Sections 4–5 and the appendices.

after.justification: v4 retains the original CSR benchmark results, retrieval measurements and ablation findings in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: The sparse encoder, TopK activation, reconstruction and contrastive objectives, and inference procedure remain unchanged. Table 3 revises a reported experimental width without establishing a change to the proposed method.

E1.justification: Both versions retain ImageNet-1K, the same MTEB classification/clustering/retrieval datasets, and COCO/Flickr30K multimodal retrieval, including CC3M-trained zero-shot evaluation. No training or evaluation coverage changes.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the corresponding figures and tables, including MRL variants, SAE, SVD, random-feature methods, quantization and the text embedding baselines. The removed Lai citation concerns related work, not an evaluated baseline.

E3.justification: Appendix Table 3 changes the reported ResNet50 hidden dimension from h=512 to h=8192, with d=2048. This aligns with the existing h=4d default in Sections 4 and 4.3. Other settings remain unchanged; the PDFs do not establish that experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: The retrieval-scaling, backbone-size, hidden-dimension and loss analyses in Figures 3–6 are retained unchanged, as are the multimodal dead-latent analysis in Figure 8 and multiplication-count analysis in Table 11.

E5.justification: Appendices E.1–E.2 retain the same three-random-seed and mean-performance reporting. The timing repetition and warm-up information in E.3 is also unchanged. No uncertainty-reporting or statistical-testing changes appear.

E6.justification: The plotted findings and result tables retain the same numerical entries, rankings and trends, including Tables 1–2, 4–5 and 11. Table 3's hidden-dimension revision concerns an experimental setting, not a performance result.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, Equations 1–7, attributed NCL Theorem 5 and sparse-multiplication reasoning in Appendix E.4 remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution list and conclusion retain the same claims about CSR's adaptive sparse representations, accuracy, retrieval efficiency and training-cost advantages over MRL.

C2.justification: Interpretations of retrieval efficiency, hidden-width effects and contrastive mitigation of dead latents remain unchanged, including the multimodal limitations in Section 6 and Appendix D.4. The added general robustness remark concerns prior sparse-coding work.

D1.justification: Table 3 revises the image-experiment hidden width from 512 to 8192, making this implementation detail consistent with the stated default. Other hyperparameters, hardware descriptions and code/data access links are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2 removes the recommendation-systems example citing Lai et al. (2024), although its bibliography entry remains. It adds a sparse-coding robustness assertion and unresolved citation markers '(??)' and '?' near the robustness and concept-layer passages. The intended additional sources cannot be identified locally.

P1.justification: v4 adds funding acknowledgements, expands affiliation and correspondence details, replaces the preliminary-work notice with ICML 2025 proceedings information, and makes limited related-work and punctuation edits. The main narrative and appendix organization remain stable.

P2.justification: All eight figures and eleven tables are retained. Table 2 becomes more compact, and updated publication footnotes and acknowledgements produce limited reflow, including moving the Impact Statement from page 9 to page 10.

improvement.justification: Correcting Table 3 to h=8192 resolves its contradiction with the existing h=4d default for d=2048, modestly improving the consistency of reproducibility information. New unresolved citations in Section 2 reduce polish and traceability, tempering this benefit. The scientific evidence and conclusions remain unchanged.
